inputs.text: They want us to believe there was a ceasefire announced in Gaza five months ago, but look at what is actually happening. It is all part of a calculated, hidden agenda to completely erase these people and strip them from their past, leaving nothing of their prewar existence. The official narrative of a ceasefire is just a smoke screen to cover up ongoing, coordinated operations that ensure the contours of life remain darker and far more brutal. As 56-year-old Ahmed Baroud, a father of five currently displaced in Deir al-Balah, exposed, “Drones never stop buzzing overhead, gunfire and shelling continue almost daily and naval boats fire towards fishermen.” That constant, relentless pressure is by design—a synchronized campaign of psychological and physical dismantling managed by the powers that pull the strings.
